title: Filipino mentors helped guide Moldova's Elizaveta Kuznetsova to Miss International crown
summary: Moldova’s Elizaveta Kuznetsova was crowned Miss International 2026 in Tokyo, Japan, on Wednesday, November 25, following a pageant journey that included the guidance of Filipino mentors.
